verdict.rationale: Two probes show ente.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Ente's apps, including two-factor authentication codes, so an agent has an official entry point. The file is company-wide rather than specific to Ente Auth, and the Markdown variant of the Auth help docs returns 404, so how deep the agent-oriented coverage goes is unproven. Missing for 10: Auth-specific llms.txt content or llms-full.txt, Markdown or agent-readable versions of the Auth help pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://ente.com/llms.txt # Ente
